hero.title: Let's Connect
hero.description: Do you run a padel community, want to partner with Riviera Open, or become a sponsor? We connect players, organizers, and brands through a professional system with real-time national rankings and communities linked nationwide.

card.title: Grow your community with Riviera Open
card.description: Run retas, leagues, and tournaments without losing your identity. Every result feeds the national ranking in real time and builds your players' full history.
